rv.q: Still, it’s difficult to see the audience participation in Becoming Hamlet as much more than a gimmick.
But the let's-all-play-Hamlet conceit proves to be more performative than profound.

cn.t: This participatory Hamlet adaptation earns mixed reviews for its experimental concept of drafting audiences into the production, though critics find the execution uneven and the central gimmick more intriguing in theory than practice.
